CRAC / CHILLED-WATER LOOP - STANDARD OPERATING NOTES
Node MW-ENG-01, Row A cold aisle
----------------------------------------------------

Purpose
  Row A is cooled by a chilled-water CRAC unit. Supply-air temperature is held
  by modulating the evaporator/blower fan. The fan motor is driven by a
  variable-frequency drive (VFD) in the Row A control panel.

Control
  The VFD holds fan speed from the loop controller. Drive parameters are set at
  commissioning - do not change drive settings from a live session without an
  approved work order.

If cold aisle is climbing
  1. Confirm blower is running.
  2. Confirm chilled-water valve open and pump running.
  3. Check the drive front panel / HMI for an active fault code.
  4. Escalate per the DC-EAST runbook.
